basic_details.organization_name: Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research (JNCASR)
basic_details.short_information: The Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research (JNCASR) has officially announced the Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical) Recruitment 2026 with 1 opening. The detailed notification was published under Advt. No. NCU-EMR-173 at https://www.jncasr.ac.in. Candidates who meet the maximum age limit of 35 years and hold a PhD in Chemistry or Life Sciences with good research experience and a publication record can submit their applications through email until 07 August 2026. Direct links to download the notification and application details are shared below.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for JNCASR Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 07-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JNCASR Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the JNCASR Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical) position is 07-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD in Chemistry or Life Sciences with a strong research experience and a good publication record to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this recruitment is 35 years. There is no minimum age specified.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 56,000 per month, along with HRA as per norms.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this government job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your complete application along with required documents to the specified email address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical) role?
faq.answer: The selection process for this position will involve an Online Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications.

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available for the Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical) position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job opportunity at JNCASR.

faq.question: Q10. Where is JNCASR located?
faq.answer: Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research (JNCASR) is located in Bengaluru, Karnataka, with the pincode 560064.
